insight: Saman Bank's sub-3-second latency and Tor's 71% spike in the same pass suggest divergent forces: NIN routing infrastructure healing while international transit paths face emerging congestion — these opposing signals reinforce that Iran's partial outage is not monolithic but a dynamic equilibrium of multiple independent enforcement and degradation mechanisms.
